## Functions

### func CSVRow

```go
func CSVRow(e FlattenEntry) (logicalDevice, logicalNode, dataObject, dataAttribute, fc, value, bType, enumVals string)
```

CSVRow returns the CSV columns for a FlattenEntry: Logical Device, Logical Node, Data Object, Data Attribute, FC, Value, Type, Enum. Path format is "LogicalDevice/LogicalNode.DataObject.DataAttribute" (Data Attribute can contain dots for nested paths).

### func EscapeCSVField

```go

```

EscapeCSVField quotes the field if it contains the separator, newline, or double quote.

### func FormatEntry

```go
func FormatEntry(e FlattenEntry, detailed bool) string
```

FormatEntry formats one FlattenEntry. If detailed is false, output is "Path: Value" only. If detailed is true, includes \[FC], \[type:BType], and \[enum:...].

### func WriteCSV

```go
func WriteCSV(w io.Writer, sep string, entries []FlattenEntry) error
```

WriteCSV writes flattened SCL entries as CSV to w. Separator is used between fields (e.g. "," or "|").
